image_description: A close-up shot of a pile of bagels. The primary subject is a plain, glossy bagel in the foreground with a golden-brown crust and a visible central hole. Behind it are other bagels, including one topped with poppy seeds and another partially visible on the left. The lighting highlights the shiny, boiled-then-baked texture of the crust.
